items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Marshall Fisher, a friend, stopped by to say hello to Mr. Nicholas.

ctx.x: Well with Basie! He and Herschel were together. You know what I mean. Herschel's tone was heavier and Lester's tone was light and so I knew right then that I was going to lean toward...try to perfect a deep, rich tone. I loved Lester, but I--you know-- I leaned toward the heavy sound, you know.

(At this point in the interview Marshall Fisher, a friend, stopped by to say hello to Mr. Nicholas. As Mr. Fisher is a person long familiar with the jazz scene, I turned the recorder on during their conversation. Part of this is transcribed below.)
